text: The Manager, Toronto Newcomer Office, will present the Newcomer Strategy 2022-2026. On October 28, 2021, the Toronto Francophone Affairs Advisory Committee requested the Director, Arts and Culture Services, Economic Development and Culture to amend the Committee's work plan to include a presentation on the Toronto Newcomer Strategy (Item FA2.6).

The Francophone Affairs Advisory Committee recommends that: 1. City Council direct the Manager, Toronto Newcomer Office, to ensure that Toronto's Francophone population plays an active role in the implementation of the Toronto Newcomer Strategy 2022-26 and to report back in 2023 to the Francophone Affairs Advisory Committee or the Economic and Community Development Committee, as appropriate, on the involvement of Francophone communities.
